component.summary: AI-native desktop code editor built on VS Code (Code - OSS).

description.p: Caudate IDE combines autonomous multi-agent workflows, inline diff editing (Ctrl+K), Next Edit Prediction, headless browser verification, MCP tool support, and local/cloud AI providers (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible APIs) with zero mandatory sign-in.
